Direct 1:1 USDC mint/redeem against M/T-bill backing. ⚠️ THE ARB PATH IS PERMISSIONED: only ONBOARDED holders can run it, so the mechanism that defends the peg is not available to the marginal secondary buyer. That is narrower than USDC's open path and more robust than a synthetic RWA wrapper — the score sits between them deliberately. ⚠️ A PLANNED STRC ROTATION IS FORWARD RISK CARRIED IN THIS SCORE and was still unrealized as of 2026-08-11; if it lands, this basis needs re-arguing, not re-dating.

backing.backing_score_denominator: ⚠️ collateral_ratio 100.0 IS AN IDENTITY, NOT EVIDENCE. Backing is defined as PYUSDx held, and PYUSDx held is minted against supply, so the ratio cannot print anything else. It says the two sides of one issuer's ledger agree. It says NOTHING about whether the portal-layer reserves exist. Never quote '100% collateralized' for this asset without the portal caveat attached.

WHAT THIS FIELD ADDS, and it is only the part no measured field carries: (1) ⚠️ `asset()` REVERTS, so this is NOT standard ERC-4626 and `totalAssets()` is bespoke — do not reason about it with ERC-4626 intuitions, and do not treat a zero `totalAssets()` as an ERC-4626 vault reporting empty.
